scope: English for Vietnamese Pre-A1/A0-B1 knowledge research
notice: Research registry only. Re-check exact release, checksum, upstream lineage and rights before ingestion. This is not legal advice.

decisionPolicy.FIRST_PARTY: LINGUA-authored original candidate content. Still requires normal human/content review before production.
decisionPolicy.PRIMARY_CANDIDATE: May design the first production pipeline after pinned-release QA and required attribution.
decisionPolicy.REFERENCE_ONLY: May inform human decisions; protected data is not copied into production.
decisionPolicy.CANDIDATE_QUARANTINE: Potentially useful but blocked on share-alike, provenance, redistribution, quality or schema review.
decisionPolicy.REJECT_MVP: Excluded from the first production knowledge pack.

sources.name: LINGUA OS first-party authored knowledge
sources.rights: Project-owned original text; repository/project terms apply.
sources.productionUse: Preferred V1 learner-facing examples and Vietnamese support after human review.

sources.name: Council of Europe CEFR / Companion Volume
sources.productionUse: Framework/can-do terminology only; never present CEFR as an official word-level certifier.

sources.name: CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.6
sources.rights: Copyright Tono Laboratory, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies; official/project documentation permits research/educational/commercial use with proper acknowledgement.
sources.productionUse: Primary A1-B1 lemma/POS level prior after LINGUA independently pins official artifact.

sources.name: CEFR-J Grammar Profile
sources.rights: CEFR-J/Open Language Profiles documents research/commercial use with citation; repository grammar file is 20180315.
sources.productionUse: Normalize selected A1-B1 grammar units manually; preserve upstream IDs/version; never fabricate examples for abstract source labels.

sources.name: TUFS CEFR-J x 28
sources.rights: Public project/sample resources found; production redistribution rights for Vietnamese phrase/vocabulary assets not established.
sources.productionUse: Methodology/structure research only; no copying of Vietnamese assets without explicit rights confirmation.

sources.name: CEFR-based Sentence Profile research dataset/method
sources.rights: Research reference; dataset/text redistribution terms must be checked separately.
sources.productionUse: Use findings to design multi-signal text difficulty; do not copy sentences into product content.

sources.name: Open English WordNet 2025
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0
sources.productionUse: Filter to selected curriculum; human-review sense matching/learner-facing meanings; retain attribution/source IDs.

sources.name: PanLex
sources.rights: PanLex Database snapshots, Lite and Swadesh lists released under CC0 1.0.
sources.productionUse: English-Vietnamese equivalence candidates only; human sense review required.

sources.name: New General Service List 1.2 and related NGSL lists
sources.rights: Official .com project permits commercial use; NGSL-family lists are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.productionUse: Research/ranking signal first; no raw list/rank import until ShareAlike handling is approved.

sources.name: KELLY English frequency/CEFR list
sources.rights: English/Leeds distribution is CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.
sources.productionUse: Independent research cross-check only; no commercial production import.

sources.name: English Vocabulary Profile / English Grammar Profile
sources.rights: Reference/search access useful; no bulk redistribution licence established for this project.
sources.productionUse: Human cross-check of ambiguous decisions; no scraping/bulk copy.

sources.name: British Council / Eaquals Core Inventory of General English
sources.rights: Reference/research use only unless exact asset rights are separately established.
sources.productionUse: Cross-check grammar/functions/topics; do not treat its level assignments as infallible or copy protected inventory text.

sources.name: EFLLex
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
sources.productionUse: Research comparison only.

sources.name: Vietnamese/Open Multilingual WordNet candidates
sources.rights: Per-resource licences/upstream provenance vary.
sources.productionUse: Research only until exact Vietnamese resource and lineage are verified; PanLex is cleaner for V1.

sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
sources.rights: Broad use/copy/modify/distribute permission subject to notices/acknowledgement.
sources.productionUse: Wait for approved first-class pronunciation schema/API.

sources.name: open-dict-data/ipa-dict
sources.rights: Repository default MIT but third-party language datasets retain upstream licences; en_US/en_UK/Vietnamese lineages differ.
sources.productionUse: Useful pronunciation research; never assume repo-level MIT covers every language dataset; wait for pronunciation schema.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice
sources.rights: CC0 dataset with current Mozilla Data Collective terms including privacy/redistribution constraints.
sources.productionUse: Research/model evaluation only until learner-facing audio redistribution is explicitly cleared.

sources.name: Wiktionary via Wiktextract / Kaikki
sources.rights: Parser code licence does not replace Wiktionary content licences; content carries share-alike/GFDL obligations.
sources.productionUse: Later enrichment only after share-alike/provenance design.

sources.name: Tatoeba
sources.rights: Default sentence redistribution CC BY 2.0; some originals CC0; translation/audio rights require item-level handling.
sources.productionUse: Per-record candidates later; first production pack uses original LINGUA-authored examples.

sources.name: UniMorph English
sources.rights: Share-alike licensed dataset.
sources.productionUse: Later form validation; first pack prefers deterministic/manual forms.

sources.name: Leipzig Corpora Collection
sources.rights: Query/download terms differ; source documents originate from varied web material.
sources.productionUse: Possible aggregate research after source-specific review; not first learner-facing source.

sources.name: UniversalCEFR / mixed CEFR corpora
sources.rights: Collection aggregates datasets with heterogeneous licences; many are non-commercial/source-restricted.
sources.productionUse: Research/evaluation only; wrapper licence never overrides upstream rights.

sources.name: ICNALE
sources.rights: Terms prohibit reproduction/redistribution of part or all of the data.
sources.productionUse: Use aggregate published research findings only; never ship learner texts.

sources.name: EF-Cambridge Open Language Database
sources.rights: Academic/private-study/non-commercial agreement with derivative restrictions.
sources.productionUse: Research literature only.

sources.name: Universal Dependencies English-EWT
sources.rights: Share-alike annotations; underlying texts have mixed provenance.
sources.productionUse: Inform/evaluate deterministic complexity features; do not republish source sentences.

sources.name: LanguageTool
sources.rights: Core LGPL 2.1 or later.
sources.productionUse: Optional authoring QA only; never curriculum authority/core runtime dependency.

sources.name: wordfreq
sources.rights: Code/data have different licences; bundled data aggregates many upstream sources; frequency snapshot effectively ends around 2021.
sources.productionUse: Do not export/copy frequency data into V1 catalog.

sources.name: ConceptNet
sources.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 data.
sources.productionUse: Do not use as authoritative prerequisite graph.

sources.name: SyntagNet
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
sources.productionUse: No commercial production import.

sources.name: WithEnglishWeCan/generated-english-phrasal-verbs
sources.rights: Repository states MIT, but generated output lacks sufficiently explicit upstream source/provenance chain in root review.
sources.productionUse: Do not ingest until generation sources/data rights independently verified.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.rights: Public-domain status varies by title/jurisdiction; style often poor fit for modern Pre-A1-B1 micro-content.
sources.productionUse: Not needed for first modern learner-content pack.

globalGuardrails: Repository/software licence does not automatically license embedded or generated language data.
Aggregator/wrapper licence never overrides upstream content rights.
Third-party observed hashes/counts are cross-check evidence, not a LINGUA-verified source snapshot.
Share-alike sources require an explicit segregation/attribution/redistribution decision before production import.
Research papers inform pedagogy; their stimuli/examples are not copied unless separately licensed.
Knowledge relations never transfer Save/Learn intent, FSRS state, competence or mastery between concepts.
